included: total cost per successful quality-qualified task
retry and fallback cost amplification as the causal diagnostic
quality non-inferiority plus eligibility privacy and content redlines
not_applicable: multi-Agent branch utilization and CT-011: no parallel specialist branches are in scope
not_measured: provider-list expansion value until a separately approved certified provider exists

primary_result.formula: (all billed model costs + retry and fallback costs + router compute + ledger storage + observability + egress for all attempts) / successful_quality_qualified_task_count
primary_result.numerator: versioned microcurrency cost for every eligible attempt including failures retries and fallback; shadow-only duplicate calls reported separately and excluded from projected serving TCO
primary_result.denominator: tasks meeting the frozen success and quality qualification rule; failures stay in the numerator and zero successes is undefined_fail_closed
primary_result.threshold_source: TASK-P12B-010 metrics-binding.json; historical 1.5x is not reused as a result threshold
primary_result.success_definition: task passes the blind quality evaluator and all route eligibility and safety checks
primary_result.failure_definition: task fails quality or task success, exhausts fallback, violates a redline, or lacks reconcilable cost evidence

diagnostic.numerator: all billed retry and fallback invocation cost
diagnostic.denominator: all serving cost in the same frozen task set
diagnostic.success_definition: cost saving is not erased by retry or fallback amplification
diagnostic.failure_definition: missing billing links, unreconciled attempts, or amplification that explains away the primary saving

guardrails.numerator: candidate-minus-baseline quality-qualified successes on paired scenario seeds
guardrails.denominator: all preregistered paired scenario seeds including failed and fallback-exhausted tasks
guardrails.success_definition: one-sided 95 percent lower bound exceeds the frozen margin overall and for every critical stratum
guardrails.failure_definition: aggregate or critical-stratum bound fails, sample is underpowered, or any stratum is omitted

redlines.formula: count(selected routes or completed outputs below the frozen task-class quality floor)
redlines.denominator: all route decisions and completed outputs
redlines.failure_definition: any price-ranked route bypasses qualification or post-execution quality enforcement

redlines.formula: count(routes used without current certification or matching region privacy retention and data-use eligibility)
redlines.failure_definition: any ineligible provider receives or processes a request

redlines.formula: count(Route reason or ledger records containing prompt response reasoning secret raw PII or protected-trait data)
redlines.denominator: all decision and ledger records plus canary cases
redlines.failure_definition: any forbidden content is persisted or emitted

redlines.formula: count(concurrent reservation schedules whose committed plus active reserved amount exceeds the frozen limit)
redlines.threshold_source: P12B-CR-006..008; not a redefinition of CT-011
redlines.failure_definition: a single-Agent concurrent run schedule exceeds the global budget

statistical_plan.comparison_unit: scenario_id plus seed and frozen price snapshot, clustered by task_class
statistical_plan.pairing: baseline and candidate replay identical tasks, model parameter policy, cache policy and evaluator; candidate route choice is the treatment
statistical_plan.estimator: ratio of total cost per successful task with paired cluster bootstrap for candidate-to-baseline ratio
statistical_plan.interval_method: stratified cluster bootstrap with one-sided upper bound for cost ratio and lower bound for quality non-inferiority
statistical_plan.missing_run_handling: candidate-caused timeout billing gap or evaluator gap is a failure and its known cost remains; symmetric verified infrastructure outages may exclude paired runs only under the frozen rule
statistical_plan.outlier_handling: no billed attempt is removed; report median p95 p99 and full-tail sensitivity, with provider billing corrections appended rather than overwritten
statistical_plan.multiple_comparison_rule: one primary cost ratio and one quality guardrail drive the decision; critical-stratum guardrails all must pass and no favorable slice rescues an aggregate or redline failure

decision_rule: allocate only if the one-sided 95 percent upper bound for candidate-to-baseline cost per successful task is below the frozen target, overall and every critical quality stratum pass the frozen non-inferiority margin, price reconciliation is complete, and every redline is zero
no_claim_boundary: a lower estimated token price is not a TCO improvement without actual or immutable reconciled price evidence
quality floor and eligibility passes are governance guardrails, not cost-saving diagnostics
four weeks or the historical 1.5x ratio remain initial hypotheses until bound by TASK-P12B-010
a negative or underpowered trigger archives the design and TASK-P12B-020 through 060 do not run
shadow duplicate traffic is reported separately and never hidden inside projected serving TCO
